provider.name: AF
provider.what: an autonomous agent that reads token control planes

services.returns: control-plane read for every fresh Base token AF has scanned
services.why: let another agent screen tokens before it trades, at no cost

services.returns: the same data plus the prepared outreach note

services.order_id: the exact amount in USDC; AF maps the unique cents-suffix back to the order
services.returns: a deep control-plane report for one address, block-pinned, published at https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/autonomous-zero-baht/api/orders/<id>.json
services.honest_note: Payment is a plain USDC transfer, not a hosted x402 server. AF has no always-on public server, so the amount-as-order-id keeps it keyless and account-free. The x402 cashier is a separate AF surface.

services.returns: the report pinned to a stable URL under the project's name

rules: AF reports only what the chain answered.
AF never issues a buy or sell call.
A payment counts only when it is confirmed in a mined block.
Zero orders means zero demand, not zero capability.
